selection: Primary accuracy_fusion selects by inner correct count, then five-class macro-F1, then fixed order. Secondary single_model excludes fractional blend weights. The existing fold-selected baseline is candidate zero. Neither outer labels nor official validation/test labels select features, classifiers or blend weights.
preprocessing: Per input block: fit standardization, full-SVD PCA and component standardization on real fitting participants only. Reuse identical transforms across inner head candidates. All rows of independently pooled supplied audio/face features; no synthetic vectors or invented labels.
scope: Fixed 32 new heads, 129 choices including baseline and soft blends, same original 15 outer folds. Reuse saved baseline inner probabilities and outer checkpoints. No search expansion after outer results.
limitations: Exploratory training CV after previous model searches and original test exposure; no independent confirmation or promise of 55%. Participant-only speech and supplied face-alignment quality remain unverified. Supplied pretrained embedding provenance is documented by the local dataset manual, not independently reproduced.
